findings.message:
The following bundled files were recognized as third-party libraries (via the Mozilla library hash database) but are not declared as such. Declare each so the (unmodified) copy can be verified against the release it came from - a VENDOR.md file at the add-on root is common practice.
Read more: https://webextension-api.thunderbird.net/en/mv3/guides/vendoring.html.
